objective: Test component improvement transfer to full302/95-muscle/body system, not tune parameters

population.shared_active_C1_scope: 284 generic C1 neurons plus 95 muscles; 18 B engineering prototypes retain point-current model and zero old density gmax

inherited_acceptance: Exact numerical values and definitions from 2026-11-09 protocol and byte-pinned analysis

definitions.B_frequency: find_peaks prominence 3 mV, no distance filter, reciprocal mean period; all 18 cells separately
definitions.B_phase: Match nearest prominent peak in 3.5..8 s to every 4..8 s peak in both directions; report count separately; no phase alignment for acceptance
definitions.calcium_drive: Per channel mean, std, q05 and q95 differences divided by max(reference q95-q05, scale floor); unshifted RMS divided by same scale; max across channels and statistics
definitions.body_shape: Transverse position after subtracting centroid and rotating head-tail axis onto x; all 49 nodes; RMS of unshifted differences
definitions.body_lateral_amplitude: max-node temporal peak-to-peak body-frame transverse position, 4..8 s; mixed abs/relative criterion
definitions.speed: Instantaneous signed centroid velocity along actual head-tail axis; compare absolute differences near zero
definitions.displacement: Euclidean centroid displacement from 4 to 8 s
definitions.mixed: Pass if difference <= max(absolute floor, relative tolerance * reference magnitude)
definitions.overall: Every listed gate must pass for both modes. Distribution statistics do not override trajectory or phase failures.
definitions.limitation: Only neural integration refined; exchange/body 1 ms and IDA settings fixed. A passing pair is operational tolerance evidence, not proof of asymptotic order.

refinement_rule: After off/live .025/.0125 ms, if ANY acceptance or inherited trace/rhythm validity criterion fails (including incomplete candidate run), run .00625 for BOTH modes. No retries or extra parameters/conditions.
reference: Finer adjacent member; also direct .025 vs .00625 when available
historical: Six old same-parameter traces copied for labeled model comparison only; none substitutes a new candidate run
protected: body binary/1ms exchange/order of body step then network advance
no extra fcurrent/rates or observer hooks
initial_current_note: INITIAL/STATE initial conditions are unchanged; native initialized currents may differ under direct readout and form part of the candidate total model change
safety_preflight: Source/generated-code matching, node/connection counts, seed initial states, actual default secondorder=0, zero-time neural/body clocks, no neuron/body advance; if critical mismatch do not start scientific conditions
failure_preservation: Frozen driver retains voltage-guard failures. Outer wrapper additionally serializes already-computed traceback-local rows after unexpected exception; no altered loop or retry.
comparison_limits: neural dt refined only, body/exchange 1ms fixed
10ms state output / 1ms feedback; sampled phase resolution retained
Do not attribute whole-model changes to muscle alone
Engineering B prototype is not physiological fit
Propulsion still speed>=10um/s AND displacement>=20um, independently of numerical convergence
